places.name: Veridia
places.note: The outline is ours: the book gives no coastline or border for Veridia except in Northshore.

places.name: Meldan
places.note: The capital. Where Veridia lies on the globe is ours; everything else in Veridia is placed relative to Meldan.

places.name: railway to Eldil
places.note: Trains run to Eldil (c29-b13); the route is ours.

places.name: Eldil
places.note: Where the army arrives by train (c29-b13). Not otherwise located.

places.name: Elenar Forest
places.note: West of Northshore, where the groups start (c29-b13, c29-b34). Outline ours.

places.name: Hydrafill's northern ice
places.note: Thirty kilometers from the Arctic border, says an advertisement (c11-b124); where along the border is ours.

places.name: northern sea and inlet
places.note: The pale area at the top of the battle map (c29-b34). We read the pale areas as sea: Group Naval's seaborne drones start in one.

places.name: southern sea
places.note: The pale area at the lower right of the battle map (c29-b34).

places.name: Northshore
places.note: The land between the two seas, east of the inlet: Group North reaching the inlet "cuts the Arctics off from the whole peninsula" (c29-b23). Coasts from the battle map; the western boundary, against Elenar Forest, is ours.

places.name: the eastern peninsula
places.note: Dangling off the eastern end of Northshore, between Northglade and Thaldur (c31-b61). It leaves the battle map at its right edge between the two seas; the part beyond the edge is ours.

places.name: Northglade
places.note: On the battle map (c29-b34), at the southern sea. About 1,000 km north-east of Meldan (c17-b100, c23-b86) and over 200 km from the Arctic border (c17-b101).

places.name: Northglade's island
places.note: About twenty kilometers wide, too small for simplified maps (c31-b4), which is why the battle map does not draw it. We put it at the coast where the battle map has Northglade.

places.name: the island's summit
places.note: Northglade's main city lies to its east (c31-b5).

places.name: border river
places.note: The line between Veridian and core Arctic territory, reached by Group North (c30-b73). We run it west from the head of the inlet.

places.name: Arctic core (west of the inlet)
places.note: Across the river from Veridia (c30-b73).

places.name: Group North
places.note: The battle map's dashed route (c29-b34).

places.name: Group Center
places.note: Drawn as on the book's battle map (c29-b34). The text differs: "I'm leading Group Center, our task is to cross the forest directly east." (c29-b25; world guide wg-367)

places.name: Group South
places.note: Drawn as on the book's battle map (c29-b34). The text differs: "I'm leading Group South, our task is to cross the forest, move toward the southeast, and then set up a perimeter on the outskirts of Northglade." (c29-b27; world guide wg-368)

places.name: Thaldur
places.note: An island east of Northshore, core Arctic territory (c30-b74), beyond the eastern peninsula (c31-b61). Size and distance ours.

places.name: Telten
places.note: Arctic core territory hundreds of kilometers east of Northglade, reached by sea (c29-b104). The book does not say whether it is on Thaldur or the Arctic mainland; we put it on Thaldur's west coast.

places.name: Arctic Empire
places.note: North of Veridia and of the United Cities. The outline is ours; the book fixes only that it lies north of Northshore and of Redshire.

places.name: Glasscrown
places.note: A month and a half of polar night (c31-b44) puts it far north; where exactly is ours.

places.name: United Cities
places.note: The coastline is ours; the book says only that the continent has many mountains and peninsulas (c10-b143).

places.name: gulf between Redshire and Arturia
places.note: The seaborne drone heads west from Redshire's coast to Arturia's (c26-b149, c26-b151). The gulf's shape is ours.

places.name: Redshire's south islands
places.note: Redshire has islands in the south (c4-b73). We put them in the gulf.

places.name: Redshire
places.note: Where the United Cities sit on the globe is ours. Nothing in the United Cities lies due north of Redshire (c10-b149, c13-b11).

places.name: Arturia
places.note: The book: "the seaborne drone making its way westward away from the Redshire coast" (c26-b149), then "The targets have successfully arrived on the coast of Arturia." (c26-b151). We put Arturia north-west of Redshire so the co-governance links don't cross; the chapter 5 figure (c5-b46) shows links between cities, not a map.

places.name: Petersvil
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Devanvil
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Imber
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Hapton
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Deplexi
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Inglewore
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Silverbeach
places.note: Farther from Redshire than Freetown (c15-b25).

places.name: Mabuli
places.note: Farther from Redshire than Freetown (c15-b25).

places.name: Freetown
places.note: Nearly the farthest from Redshire; only Silverbeach and Mabuli are farther (c15-b25).

places.name: Ondak
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Iptak
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Belpaki
places.note: Its neighbors are the book's (c5-b46); its position is ours, moved as little as possible from the book's diagram.

places.name: Messalia
places.note: South of the United Cities: the Arctics would "go south" to it after them (c28-b33).

places.name: Haragmir
places.note: As Messalia.
